arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import parse

# Test more complex valid cases
test_valid = [
    '{{}}',  # just escaped braces
    '{name[0]}',  # dict access
    '{hello.world}',  # dotted name
    '{:d}',  # anonymous typed field
    '{{{}}}',  # escaped outer, field inner
]

for t in test_valid:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(t)
        print(f"OK: {t!r} -> {p._expression}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"ERROR (should be OK): {t!r} - {e}")

print()

# Edge case: multiple levels of escaping
test_edge = [
    '{{{{hello}}}}',  # {{ and }} are escaped, leaving {hello} which is a field... wait no
]

for t in test_edge:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(t)
        print(f"OK: {t!r} -> {p._expression}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(f"ERROR: {t!r} - {e}")
EOF
